summary: I don't have the exact stat but something like 90% of all fake news gets spread on something like 7 web properties and facebook owns four of them. Want to help stop fake news? Get off facebook. It really is that simple and that complex.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I don't have the exact stat but something like 90% of all fake news gets spread on something like 7 web properties and facebook owns four of them. Want to help stop fake news? Get off facebook.

It really is that simple and that complex.
